source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
If one or more failures are found,
   1. contact the person who performed the test, to confirm that no mistakes were made
   2. confirm that the test sample is in conformance to the design specification, and that the test method was implemented correctly
3. If the performance failure happened reliably, and is understood by the person who performed the tests and others who are familiar with the design,
   1. continue documenting, knowing that the design requirements are inadequate
4. If the failure happened rarely, and no clear candidate causes of failure were identified or established,
   1. document the extent of the failure according the process described in [this document](https://github.com/open-heart-flow/Open-Heart-Flow/tree/main/Manuals/Spec_Testing/Failures%20and%20Crashes%20in%20Design%20Performance%20Testing
